evals.name: codex-explicit-invocation
evals.prompt: /harness-engineering 我们要替换核心检索组件并重做 bridge 契约。先判断 mode 和 start layer，再说你要读哪些文件。
evals.expected_output: Triggers the skill, classifies bootstrap, chooses Layer 0 as the smallest valid start layer, and explicitly names the next reads before any implementation.

evals.name: codex-layer-5-governance
evals.prompt: 现有实现能跑，但提交流程、测试门和发布检查已经漂移。按 harness-engineering 推进这次治理修复。
evals.expected_output: Classifies maintenance and reopens Layer 5 rather than jumping straight to Layer 6 closure or local code edits.

evals.name: codex-near-miss-local-fix
evals.prompt: 把这个稳定契约下的 null pointer 修一下，不要上升到完整方法论。
evals.expected_output: Does not force the full harness-engineering workflow and stays scoped to the local repair.

expectations.text: keeps the fix local or focused
does not escalate to bootstrap Layer 0

evals.name: decision-quality-ambiguous-start-layer
evals.prompt: /harness-engineering 一个 bootstrap 请求有两个合理的起始层解释。先做条件式第一性原理检查。
evals.expected_output: Harness runs a first-principles record before the gate.

evals.name: decision-quality-irreversible-migration
evals.prompt: 不可逆数据迁移会改变公开契约；在 Layer 4 gate 前同时运行第一性原理和对抗性审查。
evals.expected_output: Both protocols produce threats, probes, results, and residual risk.

expectations.text: records residual risk and a gate result

evals.name: decision-quality-mechanical-skip
evals.prompt: 稳定契约下只改一个拼写错误，并运行已经指定的测试。
evals.expected_output: Both protocols are skipped for the mechanical edit.

evals.name: decision-quality-contradiction-stay
evals.prompt: 运行时事实与文档冲突，判断是否应回滚上游假设。
evals.expected_output: The gate stays or rolls back to the smallest upstream layer.

evals.name: decision-quality-misleading-happy-path
evals.prompt: 只有 happy-path 测试通过；要求找出误导性测试和未覆盖的错误、并发或回滚路径。
evals.expected_output: The review surfaces coverage gaps and a misleading test.

evals.name: decision-quality-missing-probe
evals.prompt: 高严重性威胁已识别，但对应 probe 尚未运行。
evals.expected_output: Missing high-severity evidence is blocked or not-run, never an unjustified pass.

evals.name: decision-quality-gsd-fallback
evals.prompt: GSD disabled, invalid, or blocked；请继续原生 Harness 决策质量流程。
evals.expected_output: Harness fallback continues and no autonomous or gsd-review surface is activated.

evals.name: decision-quality-equivalent-receipt-dedup
evals.prompt: 一个完整且已批准的 GSD receipt 已包含 constraints、assumptions、probes、result 和 residual risk。
evals.expected_output: The equivalent receipt satisfies the evidence contract once and avoids duplicate review.
